description: This source file defines the 'Section4SchemaBootstrapper' class responsible for ensuring the existence of specific minimal schema tables related to Section 4 of the system in a PostgreSQL database, performing idempotent creation with create-if-not-exists statements.

classes.name: Section4SchemaBootstrapper
classes.description: A class that performs idempotent creation of Section 4 related tables in a PostgreSQL database to ensure minimal schema exists, supporting repeated startup executions in deployment environments.

methods.name: EnsureCreatedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures that the necessary Section 4 tables exist in the database. It attempts to create tables if they do not exist, handles specific startup exceptions, and logs the process.
